scope: Exact-year exterior-color audit for Chevrolet Silverado model years 1999 through 2007 and Chevrolet Colorado model years 2004 through 2007. Regular paint, two-tone paint, SEO or fleet paint, stripes, and SS or Classic variants remain separate. A Silverado 1500 claim is never projected to Silverado HD, a Silverado HD claim is never projected to Silverado 1500, and no color is projected across an adjacent model year.

source_priority: Retained official General Motors Heritage vehicle information kits
Official Chevrolet sales brochures or specification sheets preserved by third-party document mirrors
Official General Motors fleet guides preserved by third-party document mirrors
method.source_integrity: Every retained GM Heritage PDF is identified by the SHA-256 hash and byte count in the crawler artifact ledger. Every external PDF used for a color claim was fetched in full during this audit and hashed in memory; it was not added to the crawler or a GitHub release by this audit.
method.code_policy: Paint and SEO codes are recorded only when printed in the cited exact-year source. A missing code is null. No WA number, RPO, pair, restriction, or marketing name is carried from another year.
method.scope_policy: Source scope is explicit at the palette level. Unified Silverado source tables are not treated as proof of a separate HD palette. The 2007 Silverado Classic 1500 and the new-body Silverado 1500 are separate palettes. The 2007 Silverado Classic 1500HD page is documented as excluded evidence.
method.absence_policy: Not located means only that the reviewed exact-year sources did not contain a governing table for that program. It is not proof that no dealer, fleet, or special-order channel offered the program.

validation_expectations.model_year_grain: One year object per requested model and year.
validation_expectations.source_reference_integrity: Every source_ref.source_id must resolve to exactly one source object.
validation_expectations.program_uniqueness: program_id values must be unique within each model year.
validation_expectations.scope_guard: No palette claims Silverado HD availability. HD strings appear only in exact source-scope descriptions, shared-lineup caveats, and explicit exclusions, including the separately reviewed 2007 Classic 1500HD page.
validation_expectations.unresolved_year_policy: An unresolved or partial year must contain an explicit limitation and must not receive colors inferred from another year.
